newsitem.title: DENMARK: Carlsberg says to buy Bass' Carlsberg-Tetley stake.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg says to buy Bass' Carlsberg-Tetley stake.

text.p: Danish brewer Carlsberg on Friday said it would buy British partner Bass' 50 percent holding in their Carlsberg-Tetley alliance for 110 million pounds ($183 million).

The announcment followed a British government ruling that blocked the planned Bass purchase of Carslberg's half of the joint venture but said Bass must sell its existing stake. ($ = 0.600 British Pounds)
